name: [👶👶 TWINS & TRIPLETS] SweetPit City 🏠 RP
desc:
🌸 SweetPit City: a new island to live your story!

👶 Adopt a baby and watch it grow: Newborn → Crawler → Toddler!
🍼 Feed, bathe, change diapers, play and put your baby to sleep.
🏡 Buy your dream home, adopt a pet and raise a family.
👗 Hundreds of outfits, hairstyles and accessories.
💼 20+ jobs: doctor, police, teacher, firefighter, barista and more!
📱 Your own phone: photos, posts and followers.
🚐 30+ vehicles, go-karts and jet skis.
🎡 Pier, cinema, airport, beach, fishing and lots of places to explore.

👍 Like the game to support new updates!

🌍 English, Turkish and more languages
✨ New updates every week!
